name: Qwen Image 2.1
creator: Qwen team, Alibaba
observation: Keeping a character recognizable across edited views gives the 3D stage a much stronger starting point.

name: Qwen3-VL
creator: Qwen team, Alibaba
observation: Image understanding and language conditioning work together here to interpret the reference and turnaround instructions.

name: BiRefNet
creator: Peng Zheng and collaborators
observation: Careful foreground separation helps preserve the silhouette before the image becomes geometry.

name: DINOv3
creator: Meta AI and collaborators
observation: Reusable visual features let the geometry model work with structure across the reference views.

name: Pixal3D
creator: Tsinghua University, Tencent ARC Lab and Victoria University of Wellington
observation: Its pixel-aligned approach gives image-to-3D correspondence a concrete geometric foundation.

name: Powered by Hi3D 1.0
creator: Hi3D team
observation: Refining an existing mesh lets us build on a useful shape instead of starting the geometry over.

name: TRELLIS.2
creator: Microsoft Research
observation: Structured 3D representations bring detailed shape and appearance into the same generation pipeline.

name: ComfyUI
creator: Comfy Org and community contributors
observation: Visible, connected stages make it possible to preserve successful work and improve one part at a time.

name: Blender
creator: Blender Foundation and contributors
observation: A capable open 3D toolset makes the final assets practical to inspect, edit and exchange.

name: QuadriFlow via pyQuadriFlow
creator: QuadriFlow researchers and wrapper contributors
observation: Automatic quad layouts give further modeling a useful starting structure; deformation still needs its own checks.

name: PyMeshLab
creator: Visual Computing Lab, ISTI-CNR
observation: A mature set of mesh-processing filters helps turn geometry cleanup into measurable, repeatable steps.

name: MeshLib
creator: MeshInspector contributors
observation: Solid modeling tools help handle contact and repair cases that need more than a polygon reduction.

name: ComfyUI-Trellis2
creator: visualbruno and contributors
observation: This integration makes it possible to texture the geometry after our refinement and cleanup stages.

creator: hyz317 and the HairDeck researchers
observation: Predicting editable hair cards and matching spring chains in one representation makes the route from an image to a moving hairstyle unusually direct.

creator: FengLairh and contributors
observation: Native Comfy model management and a reproducible export path turn the research into a practical local workflow.

creator: Meta and the SAM 3 researchers
observation: Semantic segmentation gives the hairstyle and face their own explicit regions before 3D generation.

creator: Sperid Labs; Comfy-Org native integration
observation: One reference becomes an explorable Gaussian splat, preserving appearance alongside independently useful geometry.

creator: Microsoft Research and collaborators
observation: Estimating a camera from the source image gives controlled reconstruction a measurable starting point.

name: Garment Particles
creator: Kiyohiro Nakayama and collaborators from Stanford University, The University of Tokyo, Institute of Science Tokyo and ETH Zurich
observation: The authors’ joint 2D and 3D representation lets you generate, edit and rebuild garments from patterns, silhouettes and points. Foundry adds cloth simulation on your character and optional skinning.
